In safe mode no third-party app runs, so it cannot stop you from removing it.

1. Press and hold the power button.
2. Press and hold "Power off" until it offers "Safe mode" and accept (on some Xiaomi phones: power off, turn on and hold Volume down while it boots).
3. Go to Settings › Apps, find the app and uninstall it.
4. Restart normally.

Steps vary by manufacturer.
# Cleaner: apps that would not uninstall. Paste each line into the computer terminal.

With the phone connected to the computer over USB and USB debugging on (Settings › Developer options), type these lines into the computer terminal. Each app\'s second line is only needed if the first one answers "Failure": it leaves the app unable to run.
